title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: Your first email to parents
hook: What goes in your first email to parents?
intro: Parents are waiting to hear from you.
statement: The first message sets the tone for the whole season.
q1: Do you send a short note with the basics —
q2: or a longer one that covers everything up front?
q3: What do parents ask you most every season?
t1: Both can work. But the season starts calmer
t2: when parents know what to expect.
cta: Coaches — what is in your first email?
ctaLines: Schedule. How to reach you. What you value.
ctaPrompt: Share your first-email habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What goes in your first email to parents?
The roster just came out. Parents are waiting to hear from you.
The first message sets the tone for the whole season.
A short note or a full guide. There is no single right way.
What is in your first email? Share your habit in the comments.
